entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 174 aa sequence contains one ambiguous residue X.
Pfam Ham1p_like domain PF01725.22 spans residues 2–171; i-Evalue 6.1e-51.
Closest reviewed homologs include Q2RN61, Q5NRL7, and A5E8I8, with 47.3–54.3% identity and 93.7–98.3% query coverage.
Function assignment is moderate homology support, not direct biochemical characterization of this exact sequence.

entities.name: dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Reviewed homolog annotations assign EC 3.6.1.66 and describe hydrolysis of noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates to monophosphates.
Annotated preferred substrates include XTP, dITP, and ITP.
Reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28610.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis
observations: dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28342.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis
observations: ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:29399.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated to bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit; Mg2+ supports diphosphate-cleaving phosphohydrolase activity.
